newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City plans 40 superstores in NYC.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City plans 40 superstores in NYC.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc., the largest U.S. retailer of brand-name consumer electronics and major appliances, said Monday it will open 40 superstores in New York City by the end of 1999, including about 15 in 1997.
The Richmond, Va.-based retailer, which also sells personal computers and music software, said the new stores will create as many as 1,500 jobs.
Circuit City also said it will manage all of its 44 stores in the Northeast from New York.
The company has 429 superstores, five stores that sell only consumer electronics, 47 mall-based Circuit City Express stores and six CarMax Superstores in the United States.
The company did not say what it would spend to open the stores or how much it expected them to contribute to its earnings. Officials were not immediately available to comment.
Circuit City's stock fell 37.5 cents to $29.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
